title: Not dishwasher safe
text: Not dishwasher safe. Seems like a fine bowl, but it's not dishwasher safe.

product_metadata.title: Ramen Soup Bowl Air Tight Lid, Handle. Double Wall Insulated Thermal Stainless Steel Rapid Noodle Cooker. Instant Regular Ramen Only With Hot Water (44oz 1 Pack, New Pink)
features: Insulated Double Wall Thermal Structure Stainless Steel Pot. No Condensation. Double wall keeps the heat inside. Outside surface is safe. 44 oz Big size enough for regular ramen.
Lid with Air steam hole at center. Tight Seal Silicone packing keeps the heat inside and makes fast cook. Ergonomic Stable Grip Handle.
Instant Noodle and Regular Ramen : Double Wall structure and Air tight seal keeps the heat. Prefect for instant and regular ramen only with hot water.

Multi Purpose Bowl : Great as Sealed Food container. Use it as an instant noodle bowl, as soup bowl with lids and handles for canned soup as an insulated vacuum thermos bowl, It keeps the hot food for long hours. Cute Lunch box bowl.
High Quality Stainless Steel Bowl. Lead free, Cadmium free, no styrofoam.
